mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Over any 2-year window, the 20-day forward returns during FEDFUNDS declines are not significantly higher than average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 5.0% triggers strong labor market confidence, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE crosses below 5.0%, the subsequent 20-day S&P 500 returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signal robust economic growth, creating a virtuous cycle that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous 3mo average AND INDPRO > previous 3mo average
failure_condition: The interaction of rising GDPC1 and INDPRO does not consistently predict positive returns (e.g., 20-day returns are not significantly positive when both are above thresholds).

mechanism_narrative: Rising HOUST (demand) indicates strengthening business activity, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST peaks and then declines within the next 5 trading days, leading to negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO supply index reflects healthy production growth, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth slows or turns negative in the subsequent 60 days, resulting in underperformance relative to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Both rising labor demand (PAYEMS) and business demand (GDPC1) create a synergistic effect, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous 3mo average AND GDPC1 > previous 3mo average
failure_condition: Either labor demand or business demand is high while the other is low, or combined signals do not correlate with positive returns (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, ultra-low federal funds rates (<1%) combined with very low unemployment (<4%) signal maximum monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In contraction regimes, the same FEDFUNDS <1% and UNRATE <4% conditions produce negative returns, or returns are not significantly positive when both are met.

mechanism_narrative: Both high demand (GDPC1) and robust supply (INDPRO) indicate peak economic activity, pushing equity valuations higher and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or INDPRO is above threshold while the other is below, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive when both are high.
